items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and General Nature Thereof
Funding Support for Kindle Communities Supportive Housing - 2023-325
notes:
Colleen Clack-Bush, Deputy Chief Administrative Officer, Public Services, provided opening remarks.

The following delegate spoke on the item:
Susan Watson

The following registered delegate did not speak on the item:
Morgan Dandie

motions.item_title: Funding Support for Kindle Communities Supportive Housing - 2023-325
motions.text: That an additional $500,000 be awarded to Kindle Communities for the supportive housing project at 10 Shelldale Crescent from the Affordable Housing Reserve (#119) That to the satisfaction and authority of the City Solicitor and Deputy Chief Administrative Officer of Public Services, the necessary agreements be updated and executed with Kindle Communities to fund, outline, and monitor project criteria for the supportive housing project at 10 Shelldale Crescent.
motions.text_html:
1. That an additional $500,000 be awarded to Kindle Communities for the supportive housing project at 10 Shelldale Crescent from the Affordable Housing Reserve (#119)
  2. That to the satisfaction and authority of the City Solicitor and Deputy Chief Administrative Officer of Public Services, the necessary agreements be updated and executed with Kindle Communities to fund, outline, and monitor project criteria for the supportive housing project at 10 Shelldale Crescent.

motions.text: That By-law numbered (2023)-20822, is hereby passed.
That the meeting be adjourned. (6:22 p.m.)
